[{"word":"weary","pronun":"[ˈwɪri]","translation":"adj. 疲倦的；厌烦的；令人厌烦的

vi. 楔入；挤进","audio":"wedge.mp3"},{"word":"weird","pronun":"[wɪrd]","translation":"n. （苏格兰）命运；预言

vi. 忍住；克制","audio":"withhold.mp3"},{"word":"witness","pronun":"[ˈwɪtnəs]","translation":"n. 证人；目击者；证据

vi. 作证人","audio":"witness.mp3"},{"word":"workshop","pronun":"[ˈwɜːrkʃɑːp]","translation":"n. 车间；研讨会；工场；讲习班","audio":"workshop.mp3"},{"word":"worthwhile","pronun":"[ˌwɜːrθˈwaɪl]","translation":"adj. 值得做的，值得花时间的","audio":"worthwhile.mp3"},{"word":"worthy","pronun":"[ˈwɜːrði]","translation":"n. 杰出人物；知名人士

vi. 失事；营救失事船只","audio":"wreck.mp3"},{"word":"wrench","pronun":"[rentʃ]","translation":"n. 扳手，扳钳；扭伤；痛苦；歪曲；猛扭

vi. 扭伤；猛扭；猛绞","audio":"wrench.mp3"},{"word":"wrestle","pronun":"[ˈresl]","translation":"n. 摔跤；搏斗；斗争

vi. 起皱
vt. 使起皱纹","audio":"wrinkle.mp3"}]
